tasks.label: Build Debug
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' make debug -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release (time-thc)
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' CXXFLAGS='-DDUCKDB_ENABLE_HASH_JOIN_TIMERS=1' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: RS on ASH-datagen
tasks.command: cd /mnt/local_ssd/spy; GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' make release -j $(nproc); cd ASH-datagen; ./launch_release.sh rs

tasks.label: RS on ASH-datagen (time-thc)
tasks.command: cd /mnt/local_ssd/spy; GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' CXXFLAGS='-DDUCKDB_ENABLE_HASH_JOIN_TIMERS=1' make release -j $(nproc); cd ASH-datagen; ./launch_release.sh rs
